title: Installer local auto-install flow

context.summary: Add a real installer-managed local model auto-install path with resource preflight, pull/install commands, health checks, logs and rollback diagnostics.
context.background: TASK-122 added the local model runner catalog and TASK-123 wired supported local runners into Compose profiles. The installer still needs explicit user choices and execution for selected local model runners.

in: Add installer answer-file and env settings for local model auto-install, selected runner ids and retry count.
Expose local model runner choices in the wizard with catalog resource hints.
Disable roles explicitly when the user declines the catalog runner that would satisfy them.
Add an install step that preflights selected runners, starts required Compose services, pulls/downloads supported runner models, writes logs and verifies health.
Add rollback-safe state for installer-created local model install metadata.
Add validation, docs and acceptance coverage for the local model auto-install path.
out: Adding heavy experimental runner images beyond the current Compose profiles.

acceptance_criteria: Installer answers, generated .env and mindory.config.json persist local model auto-install settings.
Wizard prompts include local model runner choices with resource hints from LOCAL_MODEL_RUNNER_CATALOG.
Declining a local runner disables the LLM roles covered only by that runner instead of leaving half-configured roles.
Selected supported local runners are preflighted, installed through real Compose commands, retried, logged under MINDORY_HOME/logs and health-checked.
Ollama selected runners pull their configured model names before runtime health succeeds.
Failed local model install stops the installer with clear diagnostics and journal rollback state.
pnpm installer:validate, pnpm tasks:validate and pnpm check pass before merge.

manual_checks: Confirm local model auto-install uses @mindory/llm/Compose surfaces and does not add direct model calls to API or worker code.

risks: Real Ollama model pulls require network and can be slow, so validator coverage uses command runner assertions while live acceptance remains explicit.
definition_of_done: Branch is committed and merged back into master.
